# HOPn

> HOPn is a European innovation hub connecting business, education, and
> research to build and scale AI solutions, data products, digital twin
> systems, and advanced engineering capabilities — combined with consulting,
> talent, and training.

HOPn is a research and engineering company, not an AI product. Its services
span consulting, applied AI and data engineering, digital twins, robotics,
healthcare and eldercare technology, talent placement, and corporate
training. Full details are published on the site below in English, German,
and Arabic.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.hopn.eu/en): Overview of HOPn's mission and areas of work.
- [Services](https://www.hopn.eu/en/services): Consulting, AI solutions, data, digital twins, robotics.
- [Industries](https://www.hopn.eu/en/industries): Sectors HOPn works in.
- [Insights](https://www.hopn.eu/en/insights): Articles and research notes.
- [About](https://www.hopn.eu/en/about): Mission, team, and company background.
- [Contact](https://www.hopn.eu/en/contact): How to reach HOPn.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Content is available in English (/en), German (/de), and Arabic (/ar).
- Claims about clients, partners, and results on this site are only shown
  once verified by HOPn; absence of a section (e.g. case studies) means none
  are published yet, not that the page failed to load.
